caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent green glass pitcher centered on a unadorned beige background. The pitcher has a round body with a slightly bulging lower half featuring a spiral, ribbed design. The neck of the pitcher is cylindrical and narrows as it approaches the wide, outward-flaring mouth. There is a single, curved handle attached to the upper neck and the top side of the body, which is also rendered in the same green glass material. The base is slightly raised and circular, appearing darker to suggest thickness or shadow. The glass is lightly shaded to indicate its translucent quality, and the drawing contains delicate highlights and reflections that emphasize the shape and clarity of the pitcher. There are faint, irregular, light brownish stains or marks visible in the background around the object.
title: Pitcher
